title: Concept: Yarn lockfile entry without a resolved version
description: yarn.lock declares a Yarn entry that records no version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The entry cannot be compared with an advisory range, so a vulnerable install is invisible to every version-based check.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through yarn.lock (npm).
risk: The entry cannot be compared with an advisory range, so a vulnerable install is invisible to every version-based check.
